theater: 河北涿郡冷陘拒馬河谷

battle.name: 冷陘之戰
battle.theater: 河北涿郡冷陘拒馬河谷
battle.brief: 冷陘之戰是唐初唐廷與東突厥在河北涿郡冷陘一線的邊境戰役：幽州長史張守珪以步槊與弩陣在拒馬河谷頂住突厥騎兵的衝鋒，再以精騎分割追擊，迫其退回漠北。卡面兵器是亞述長矛，短柄、長刃、鐵鏃，正是冷陘唐軍步槊所承襲的長矛兵種源流。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏃。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 交戰的兩方是唐王朝與東突厥汗國。唐一方在河北前沿的實際指揮者，是幽州長史張守珪所率的幽州軍：漢兵為主，另雜有附唐的契丹、奚、靺鞨等蕃兵，糧秣由邊州都督、縣官與屯田校尉就地供給，戰馬多出自太行山東麓與河邊諸州的牧馬監；開元年間節度使一制尚未普及，邊鎮的調兵與出戰仍靠長史、都督與行軍總管臨時調度。唐廷在朔方、河東也屯有重兵，但冷陘一線的接戰全由幽州方面承擔。東突厥汗國是游牧聯盟式的帝國，汗庭在漠南牙帳，以可汗為首，下分阿史那諸部與若干歸附部落，軍隊以輕騎為主，人數記載多有誇大；同一時期的契丹、奚、渤海在燕山南北與突厥、唐之間往來，時而附突厥、時而附唐。冷陘之戰因此不是兩國常備大軍的會戰，而是唐邊鎮守軍與突厥游騎在燕山南麓的一場遭遇。
countriesEn: The two sides in this war were the Tang dynasty and the Eastern Turkic Khaganate. On the Tang side, command on the Hebei front actually rested with Zhang Shougui, military administrator of Youzhou, and the Youzhou troops under him: mostly Han soldiers, supplemented with Xian, Khitan and Jurchen auxiliaries attached to the Tang, supplied with grain and provisions by the commandery and county officials of the border prefectures and by the farming garrisons, and with war horses drawn largely from the pastures on the eastern foot of the Taihang Mountains and from the river-side prefectures of the north. In the Kaiyuan era the system of jiedushi had not yet spread, and troops were still mustered and committed by the older offices of military administrator and commandant and by commanders appointed ad hoc for a campaign. The court also kept heavy forces posted at Shuofang and Hedong, but at Lengjing the contact was borne entirely by the Youzhou command. The Eastern Turkic Khaganate was a nomadic confederation ruled from the southern steppe by the qaghan, subdivided among the Ashina clans and a number of dependent tribes, with light cavalry as the core of its armies; the headcounts in the sources are usually exaggerated. At the same time the Khitan, the Xi and the Balhae moved between the Yan Mountains and the steppe, attaching now to the Turks and now to the Tang. Lengjing was therefore not a set-piece battle between the full armies of two states, but an encounter between the garrison of a Tang border command and Turkic raiding cavalry at the southern foot of the Yan Mountains.
people: 唐方主帥是幽州長史張守珪，出身岐州，在玄宗一朝以邊功著稱；他治邊的風格是主動出擊，不甘坐守城池，與當時主張以封賞羈縻對待突厥的朝臣取向不同。張守珪麾下的將校中，日後最有名的兩人是營州出身的安祿山與史思明：安祿山通六蕃語、熟悉蕃部風俗，能在軍中溝通漢蕃，屢次隨張守珪出擊奚、契丹而受拔擢；史思明亦通蕃語，能以數種蕃語交涉。二人此時還只是邊鎮偏將，冷陘之役中他們的具體戰績史無明文，但這段在幽州軍中練出的騎射與統兵經驗，後來成了安史之亂時叛軍骨幹的由來。突厥一方，執掌汗庭者為頗斤，其後由思摩接掌汗位；史書對冷陘之戰中突厥方面的指揮者多不具名，只記其率眾來犯、遇唐軍即北潰。本站編年把此役繫於712年（唐玄宗先天元年），而《舊唐書·張守珪傳》與《資治通鑑》所載張守珪在冷陘大破突厥一事，一般繫於開元九年（721年），兩說並存，卡面取前者。
peopleEn: The Tang commander was Zhang Shougui, military administrator of Youzhou, a man from Qi prefecture who made his name on the northern frontier under Emperor Xuanzong. His style was to strike first rather than sit behind walls, which set him at odds with court officials who preferred to pacify the Turks by investiture, gifts and marriage alliances. Two of the best known of the officers under him were An Lushan and Shi Siming, both natives of the Yingzhou region: An Lushan spoke the languages of the six foreign peoples, knew the customs of the tribes, could serve as interpreter between Han and foreign in the camp, and was repeatedly raised in rank for campaigning against the Xi and the Khitan under Zhang Shougui; Shi Siming likewise spoke the foreign tongues and could negotiate in several of them. At this time the two were still only junior officers on the frontier, and no record gives their individual exploits at Lengjing, but the riding, shooting and command experience they gained in the Youzhou army later became the seed of the rebel core in the An Lushan rebellion. On the Turkic side the khanate was held by Pojin, and Simmo succeeded him; the Chinese sources rarely name the Turkic commander at Lengjing, recording only that a host came south and broke before the Tang army. This site's chronology places the battle in 712, the first year of Xiantian under Emperor Xuanzong, while the Old Book of Tang biography of Zhang Shougui and the Zizhi Tongjian generally assign Zhang's great victory over the Turks at Lengjing to Kaiyuan 9 (721); both datings stand, and the card takes the earlier.
kits: 卡面這件亞述長矛是短柄、長刃、裝鐵鏃，屬兩河流域亞述王國的步兵配裝，年代上溯至公元前九世紀，距冷陘之戰已過一千六百餘年，它本身並沒有出現在唐軍與突厥騎兵相遇的戰場上；它能代表的是長矛這一兵種的源頭形制：單手持握、與盾牌並用，葉形鏃身兼具刺擊與割殺之效，靠密集隊形而不是單人武藝取勝。冷陘之戰中功能對等的兵器是唐軍的槊，分步槊與馬槊，木杆鐵刃，刃長可達數尺，配合明光鎧與弩組成拒馬的長矛陣；突厥騎兵用的是短桿直刺的矛，配合骨角複合弓、佩刀與皮甲，人馬隨軍自帶牧群。張守珪麾下的蕃兵多備標槊，作投射之用。唐軍的鎧甲以皮甲、木甲為主，鐵鎧比例仍低，弩則以蹶張一類張力較大的器械為主，兼供野戰與攻守之用。雙方都沒有大型攻城器械投入這場野戰；冷陘一線留下的防禦痕跡是沿邊的關城、烽燧與鹿角寨，用來遲滯騎兵，而不是用來攻城。
kitsEn: The card shows an Assyrian spear: a short grip, a long blade and an iron head, the standard infantry arm of the Assyrian kingdom of Mesopotamia, a form that reaches back to the ninth century BC and stands more than sixteen hundred years away from the battle of Lengjing. The weapon itself was never on the field where Tang soldiers met Turkic riders; what it does represent is the fountainhead of the pike as an arm of service, gripped in one hand and used alongside a shield, with a leaf-shaped head serving both to thrust and to cut, winning by the density of the formation rather than by the skill of a single fighter. The functional equivalent at Lengjing was the Tang shao, in its foot and mounted forms: a wooden shaft with an iron blade several feet long, forming the pike wall that held the enemy off, arrayed with the Mingguang armour and the crossbow. Turkish riders used short-shafted thrusting spears with composite bows of horn and sinew, their curved sabres and hide armour, and they brought their own herds with the army. The foreign officers under Zhang Shougui carried pi spear-throwers for use at range. Tang armour was mostly hide and lacquered wood with iron still in the minority; the crossbows were of the strong-drew type, useful in the field as well as in defence. Neither side brought heavy siege equipment into what was a field engagement; the defensive works left on the Lengjing line were frontier forts, beacon towers and deer-horn abatis, made to slow horsemen rather than to breach walls.
tactics: 冷陘一役的戰術骨架，是唐軍用冷陘河谷的地形把突厥的騎兵優勢壓成以步制騎。唐軍先以幽州精騎前出至冷陘、拒馬河上游一帶列陣，步兵結成密排長矛陣，盾手在前、弩手在後，壓住谷口與河橋，使突厥騎兵無法展開衝鋒；弩箭在狹窄地帶橫掃騎手，等於在平原上替唐軍修了一道牆。突厥游騎的慣用戰法是散開、放箭、誘敵前鋒離陣，待唐軍隊形鬆動再回身衝殺；這一套在冷陘卻失了效，因為一旦被唐騎咬住，退路正是那條河谷。張守珪的部署正是用這一點：正面以步槊與弩頂住，兩翼以精騎同時壓上，把突入谷中的敵騎分割成數段，再沿山道追擊，把戰場從冷陘推到狼山以北。補給上，唐軍靠幽州、涿州一線的就地徵發與軍屯維持，離開城區一日即須輕裝；突厥則靠漠北牧群隨軍攜帶乳酪、肉乾與馬匹，不依賴攻城後的掠奪，因此他們的戰術選擇只有一個：贏了帶走牛羊，輸了立刻退回草原。
tacticsEn: The tactical shape of Lengjing was the Tang using the valley of the Lengjing river to compress the Turkic advantage in horsemen into a battle of foot against horse. The Tang first pushed picked cavalry out of Youzhou to take position at Lengjing and on the upper Juma river: infantry formed a dense pike line, shield men in front and crossbowmen behind, sealing the mouth of the valley and the river crossing so that Turkic horsemen could not spread out to charge, while crossbow bolts swept the narrow ground and cut down riders, in effect building a wall for the Tang in the middle of a plain. The usual Turkic method was to scatter, shoot and draw the Tang vanguard out of line, falling back on the Tang formation once it loosened; at Lengjing that method failed, because once the raiders were caught the retreat ran straight up that same valley. Zhang Shougui's deployment used exactly that: the front held the charge with pikes and crossbows while picked cavalry pressed on both flanks, cutting the riders who had entered the valley into separate segments, and the pursuit was carried along the mountain track, moving the battlefield from Lengjing to the north of Langshan. On the supply side the Tang drew grain locally from Youzhou and Zhuozhou and from the army farms, and had to travel light once beyond a single day's ride from the walled towns; the Turks carried their own dairy, dried meat and horses from the northern pastures and did not depend on plunder, so their tactical choice was a single one: take the cattle and sheep if they won, and if they lost, turn back to the steppe at once.
data: 可核對的數字不多，而且史書多有誇大，須分開看。冷陘之戰在《舊唐書·張守珪傳》與《資治通鑑》中繫於開元九年（721年），本站編年取712年（先天元年）為卡面年序。唐軍兵力，舊籍只作張守珪將兵的概括記載，通鑑則記其以輕騎追擊、斬首三萬餘級；三萬餘級在唐代邊將奏捷的通例中通常被認為有所誇大，實際戰果應以數千計。突厥方面的傳統說法是控弦百萬，此數與其實際人口不合，多半是軍勢的修辭。地理上，冷陘屬涿郡以北的拒馬河（古稱冷陘水）上游，據幽州城約二百餘里，狼山在戰場北側不遠處；冷陘至狼山一線的道路山谷與坡地相間，寬處可容數騎並行，窄處僅容一隊通過，這決定了騎兵無法展開。季節上，開元年間的北方軍役多在春末夏初動手，此時草木未生、地面鬆軟，馬力發揮受限而步卒不吃虧。時間上，交鋒在數日之內結束，唐軍追擊數十里後回軍。
dataEn: Few figures can be checked, and the sources are generous with exaggeration, so they have to be separated. The Old Book of Tang biography of Zhang Shougui and the Zizhi Tongjian place the battle of Lengjing in Kaiyuan 9 (721); this site's chronology takes 712, the first year of Xiantian, as the year for the card. Tang numbers are given only in general terms, as Zhang Shougui leading his troops, while the Tongjian records that he pursued with light cavalry and that more than thirty thousand of the enemy were beheaded. That figure of thirty thousand follows the usual pattern of Tang frontier commanders' victory reports and is generally treated as inflated, the real tally being a matter of several thousand. The traditional Turkic claim of a hundred thousand bowmen does not match their actual population and is better read as rhetoric about the size of the host. Geographically Lengjing lay on the upper Juma river, called in those days the Lengjing river, north of Zhuo commandery and roughly two hundred odd li from the city of Youzhou, with Langshan not far to the north; the road from Lengjing to Langshan alternated between valley and slope, wide enough for a few riders abreast in places and for a single column in others, and that is what kept the cavalry from deploying. As for season, northern campaigns in the Kaiyuan years were usually begun in late spring and early summer, when the grass had not yet come up and the ground was soft, so that horses were handicapped while foot soldiers were not. The fighting itself was over within days, the Tang army pursuing for some tens of li before falling back.
cause: 直接起因是突厥越邊南下，把戰火推到唐的河北牧場與村鎮上。東突厥在唐滅其汗國之後分裂，經過二十餘年的羈縻與內鬥，開元初年重新整合漠南部眾；可汗所部每年南出，掠取幽州、雲州、代州一帶的馬群與糧產。唐廷雖以封爵、賜婚與互市羈縻之，但實控只到漠南邊緣，兩邊的牧場界線從未真正劃定。突厥要的是河北的牧馬與補給，唐要的是邊境安寧，兩種需求在同一條河谷上重疊，衝突因此不可避免。更深一層的原因是制度：唐的邊鎮此時仍由長史、都督等舊官鎮守，權力與責任都壓在少數人身上，像張守珪這樣的邊將，既要對付年年入寇的游騎，也要在朝中主張以戰求安；冷陘之戰正是這種以打促和的邊防邏輯的一次實現，打得越狠，突厥越傾向承認唐對邊界的實際控制，唐廷也才有餘裕轉向西域與吐蕃。冷陘選在拒馬河谷，也因為這裡距幽州不遠、可退可守，是邊軍在牧場線上能設伏的少數幾個點之一。
causeEn: The immediate cause was a Turkic incursion south of the border that carried fire into the Tang pastures and villages of Hebei. After the Tang had destroyed the qaghanate, the Eastern Turks split apart, and after more than twenty years of dependent administration and internal struggle they were reunited at the beginning of the Kaiyuan era; the khan's host came south every year to seize horses and provisions from Youzhou, Yunzhou and Daizhou. The court answered with titles, marriage and trade, but its reach extended only to the southern rim of the steppe, and the line between the two pastures was never actually drawn. What the Turks wanted was the horses and supplies of Hebei; what the Tang wanted was quiet on the frontier. The two needs lay on top of each other in one river valley, and the clash was therefore unavoidable. Deeper down lies the institutional fact: the border commands were still held by old-style officials such as military administrator and commandant, and power and responsibility both fell on a few men, so a frontier commander like Zhang Shougui had both to answer the raids that came every year and to argue at court for fighting as a way to peace. Lengjing was one working of that logic: the harder the Tang struck, the more the Turks inclined to accept Tang control of the border, and the more room the court had to turn towards the Western Regions and towards Tibet. Lengjing was chosen in the Juma valley because it lay close enough to Youzhou to allow either withdrawal or reinforcement, and was one of the few points on the pasture line where the border army could set an ambush.
impact: 冷陘之戰的直接影響，是唐在河北的邊防從守城轉為出擊。張守珪以邊功累加升遷，開元二十一年唐廷始設節度使，他正是第一批幽州節度使之一；隨後十餘年，冷陘這條防線上再沒有出現同等規模的突厥突破，東突厥可汗把重心南移到與唐爭奪漠南，北面反而成了唐拉攏的對象。間接的影響更大：這類戰役養出了一批兼通蕃漢的邊將，安祿山、史思明都在幽州軍中累積了實際的騎射與統兵經驗，而唐廷正是靠這批人守邊，也靠這批人經營河北；開元末年安祿山兼領三鎮節度使時，河北的軍力、馬政與人事都已集中到少數蕃將之手。744年東突厥汗國被回紇拔野古打散、其眾西遷，冷陘一線的邊患至此換成新的樣貌，而《唐書》為張守珪立傳，仍把冷陘的功列為他一生最重的戰功。對後世讀史的人來說，冷陘之戰也是邊軍以少量兵力在自家地界上打散對手騎兵團的一個樣本：地形、裝備與指揮的配合，勝過單純的兵數。
impactEn: The direct effect of Lengjing was that the Tang defence on the Hebei front turned from holding cities to attacking. Zhang Shougui rose by repeated border victories, and when the court created the jiedushi in Kaiyuan 21 he was among the first Youzhou commanders to hold that title; for the next ten-odd years no Turkic incursion of comparable scale broke the Lengjing line, and the qaghan shifted his weight south to contest the steppe with the Tang, while the far north became an object of Tang diplomacy. The indirect effects were larger. Campaigns of this kind raised a generation of frontier officers who spoke both the Chinese and the foreign tongues: An Lushan and Shi Siming both accumulated real experience of riding, shooting and command in the Youzhou army, and the Tang relied on such men both to hold the border and to run Hebei. By the end of Kaiyuan, when An Lushan held three commands at once as jiedushi, the troops, horses and personnel of Hebei had all gathered into the hands of a few officers of foreign origin. In 744 the Eastern Turkic khaganate was broken up by the Uighur Pugu and its people moved west, and the character of the threat on the Lengjing line changed accordingly; yet when the compilers of the Book of Tang wrote Zhang Shougui's biography, they still set the victory at Lengjing as the heaviest of his career. To later readers the battle is also a sample of a border force breaking an enemy body of horsemen on its own ground: terrain, equipment and command working together outweighed simple numbers.
result: 結果是唐軍在冷陘一線擊破來犯的突厥騎眾，斬獲與俘獲甚眾，張守珪因功受到朝廷褒獎，突厥方面退回漠北，邊境回復對峙。史書記唐軍斬首三萬餘級、獲人畜以萬數，這組數字在唐代戰報的慣例中偏大，較可信的判斷是：唐軍確實以一次野戰重創南下的騎兵主力，迫使突厥放棄深入河北平原的企圖，把活動範圍壓回邊牆以北。對突厥而言，這一敗是又一次入寇不成反折損的循環，開元年間類似的失敗還有數次；等到頗斤之後由思摩執政，汗庭對南下的規模與時機都收斂許多，雙方在開元二十年前後進入一段以封賞、互市為主的相對平靜期，直到744年汗國被內部兼併、突厥眾西遷，這條邊線才真正換了主人。對唐而言，冷陘之戰沒有帶來新的疆土，卻把幽州一帶從年年告警的前線，變成可以屯田、可以牧馬、可以倚以出擊的基地，這才是它在唐史上被反覆提起的理由。
resultEn: The outcome was that the Tang army broke the Turkic riders who had come south at the Lengjing line, taking many casualties and prisoners, Zhang Shougui was rewarded by the court for it, and the Turks fell back to the steppe, leaving the frontier to settle again into standoff. The sources record more than thirty thousand of the enemy beheaded and great numbers of men and livestock captured; in the customary practice of Tang victory reports that group of figures runs high, and the better reading is that the Tang did break the main body of the raiding cavalry in a single field action, forcing the Turks to give up the idea of pushing deep into the Hebei plain and confining their movements north of the frontier. For the Turks this was one more turn of the cycle of raiding and losing, and similar defeats came more than once in the Kaiyuan years; by the time Simmo held the khanate after Pojin, the scale and timing of the southern raids tightened considerably, and for a stretch around the years before Kaiyuan 20 the two sides entered a relative calm built on investiture and trade. Only in 744, when the khaganate was absorbed from within and the Turkic people moved west, did that frontier line truly change hands. For the Tang, Lengjing brought no new territory; it turned the Youzhou region from a front that sounded the alarm every year into a base where troops could farm, horses could graze and armies could strike out from, and that is the reason it is raised again and again in the history of the Tang.
